entities.title: retro-games
entities.summary: Six games made with the help of AI, five of them played in the browser on icelander.net, each documented in .dev folders beside its code.
entities.purpose: The repository root holds the games in games/, the workflows that test and deploy them in .github/, the database migration procedure in docs/, the sign-in library the games' Workers vendor in vendor/icelander-auth/, the actors the .dev files name in Actors/, the skills and knowledge catalogue the .dev files follow in Meta/Agents/, and the clean-room remake skills in .claude/skills/.
boundaries: Every change reaches main through a pull request, and a merge to main deploys each game it changes; nothing here deploys by hand.
vendor/icelander-auth/ is a copy of packages/icelander-auth/ in the icelander.net repository, kept unchanged and checked against its STAMP.json; it is changed there, never here.

Meta/Agents/Skills and Meta/Agents/Knowledge are copies from the human-assisted-software-development repository, changed there and copied here, except Meta/Agents/Skills/knowledge-driven-development, which LodeStar still uses.
The games hub that relays online matches and serves /me lives in another repository; the games only connect to it.
